text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the way back to the academy after a day out, the sound of lively voices lures us to the shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: My goodness… a flea market? I see, so that's why so many people are here.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Is that—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Called it! I thought I recognized you two!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ines! Hello. Are you shopping today?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh, no, no. I'm helping out at the market!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: There's a lot of stuff here, plenty of bargains to find.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: My… There really are a lot of items for sale here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Picture books, dolls, accessories… Hehe, I feel as though I'm a child in a toy store!
choice_data_list: Since we're here, why don't we take a look?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Is that all right with you? Then yes, by all means!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Okay! Take your time. If you find anything you like, feel free to let me know!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hmm. Everything is wonderful. I just can't choose.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: What do you think, Trainer? Has anything caught your eye?
choice_data_list: Maybe this book of prized recipes from three-star restaurants.
Maybe this piece of colored paper with Gold Ship's autograph on it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: My! I had my eye on that book as well. Every dish looks exquisite.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Were you thinking of making something from this?
choice_data_list: Would you try it if I did?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, it would be no trouble at all! You should be aware, however—I'm a bit harsh when it comes to judging flavor.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh! Did you decide what to buy?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, we found something wonderful! Could we get a bag for it as well?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hehe. ♪ A flea market is certainly nothing to sneeze at!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Bwah?! Where did they get such a thing?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ah! That's our last one! It's really popular among families with kids.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Believe me, though, I was shocked myself when Gold Ship came in to offer them. Haha.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: You… have my sympathies.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: So? Should I ring you up?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: …Trainer? May I have a word with you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I want you to think this over thoroughly… carefully…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Pressured by Mejiro McQueen, I abandon the idea of buying the autograph.
